11six24-pegasus-jelly-bean-2: Loved for a soft, dense feel with control and spin; some find the power modest.
11six24-ultre-jelly-bean-2: Praised for a plush feel and control on dinks, drops and resets; a few find it slow in hand battles.
11six24-ultre-power-2: Loved for spin, pop and a large sweet spot; a good number find the feel stiff and muted.
11six24-vapor-power: Praised for easy power, a large sweet spot and good control; some find the stiff feel hard on the arm.
11six24-vapor-power-2: Liked for spin from durable grit, plus power and a generous sweet spot; some find it stiff or numb.
bread-butter-loco-hybrid: Praised for power, heavy spin and fast hands; some find the pop hard to control on dinks.
crbn2-trufoam-genesis: Loved for spin, control and a large sweet spot; some find the feel so muted it seems dead.
crbn3-trufoam-genesis: Liked for spin and a consistent, dense feel; many find it head heavy and short on power.
enhance-duo: Loved for control, spin and a large sweet spot with good pop; a couple found it narrow at first.
honolulu-j6cr: Enjoyed for spin, pop and power with a big sweet spot; some find the grit wears smooth.
luzz-cannon: Liked for pop, power and spin at a lower price; some find the power hard to control at the kitchen.
pickleball-apes-pulse: Loved for control on drops, resets and dinks with a soft feel; several report core crush or delamination.
ronbus-quanta-r3-16: Liked for power and pop at great value; some report edge guards coming loose.
ronbus-quanta-r4-16: Praised for fast hands, control and plenty of power; some report edge guards coming loose.
rpm-jade-elongated: Liked for spin, pop and easy drops and dinks; some found it hard to control at first.
six-zero-black-opal-14mm: Liked for easy power and spin; many find the small sweet spot makes resets tougher.
six-zero-coral-16mm: Praised for control with forgiving resets, drops and dinks; some report edge guards separating.
six-zero-coral-pro-16mm: Liked for control, easy resets and grit that lasts; many report dead spots near the top.
six-zero-ruby: Liked for spin, control and a plush feel; many say the grit wears smooth within months.
spartus-spitfire-elongated: Loved for spin and drive power; some find it head heavy or too poppy for touch shots.
vatic-pro-prism-flash: Praised as a soft, controlling, forgiving paddle at a low price; many say it lacks power.
vatic-pro-saga: Liked for a plush feel with power, control and spin; a couple found it nothing special.
vatic-pro-v-sol-pro: Praised as a budget paddle with good control and easy power; a few say the grit fades.
vatic-pro-v-sol-tour: Liked for spin, power and pop; many report the face going smooth within weeks.
